posts.zh:
dsh-backup 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。一键备份与恢复 DSH 用户数据：/backup 命令族与 backup_dsh 工具、可视化 Settings 面板，sha256 完整性校验与加固恢复（拒绝路径穿越/软链），定时自动备份（重启续跑、绝对节奏）、可配置轮换、归档下载路由、GitHub 私有仓库同步；macOS/Linux/Windows。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b1e9d41c30d9860d596a.html
posts.en:
dsh-backup is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. One-command backup & restore of DSH user data: /backup command family plus backup_dsh tool and a visual Settings panel, sha256 verify with hardened restore validation (path-traversal/symlink rejection), scheduled auto-backup that survives restarts on an absolute cadence, configurable rotation, archive download route, and GitHub sync to a private repo; macOS/Linux/Windows.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b1e9d41c30d9860d596a.html
